name: 420Verify
purpose: Reproducible deployed-contract source verification for the 420 Integrated blockchain without treating verification as an audit, endorsement or safety guarantee.

canonicalSources.deploymentContext: transaction, receipt, creation bytecode and block context where available
canonicalSources.registry: 420Registry / ProtocolRegistry for registered service and implementation references
canonicalSources.explorer: 420Explorer for chain navigation and presentation only
canonicalSources.appstore: 420AppStore consumes verification status as sourced security context only

requiredViews: submit source bundle and compiler configuration
verification result with exact mismatch reason
source files and compiler settings for published matches
security disclaimer distinguishing verification from audit
invariants: VER-INV-001: 420Verify owns no canonical protocol state and requires no Verify-specific Genesis contract.

VER-INV-002: A FULL_MATCH result means the submitted build reproduces the deployed runtime bytecode under the recorded compiler inputs; it does not mean the contract is audited, safe, official or non-malicious.
VER-INV-003: Every result is bound to chain ID, contract address and deployed runtime code hash so a verification result cannot be silently reused for different code or a different network.
VER-INV-004: Compiler version and relevant settings, source bundle commitment, metadata mode, library links and constructor context are preserved as verification evidence.
VER-INV-005: Metadata, immutable and linked-library differences are explicitly handled and cannot be silently discarded to manufacture a full match.
VER-INV-006: Proxy shell and implementation contracts are verified separately; verification of either one cannot imply verification or safety of the other.
VER-INV-007: A proxy implementation upgrade cannot retain a prior implementation verification result unless the new implementation code is independently verified.
VER-INV-008: Verification records and hosted source databases are non-canonical and reproducible from the recorded inputs plus canonical deployed bytecode.
VER-INV-009: 420Verify cannot register an application, grant Registry legitimacy, sign transactions, authorize Smart Account capabilities, transfer assets or exercise governance authority.
VER-INV-010: MISMATCH and UNVERIFIABLE results preserve diagnostic reasons rather than presenting ambiguous verified/unverified labels.
VER-INV-011: Alternative verification services and local reproducible builds remain possible; 420Verify availability cannot block contract interaction through Wallet, RPC or Explorer.
VER-INV-012: Published verification evidence exposes enough compiler/build information for an independent verifier to reproduce the result.
VER-INV-013: Verification status consumed by 420Explorer, 420AppStore or 420Registry must retain source provenance and must not be transformed into an audit or endorsement claim.
